description.value: ClickHouse is the fastest and most resource efficient real-time data warehouse and open-source database.
ClickHouse is a company that develops ClickHouse, an open-source, column-oriented database for real-time analytics.
ClickHouse, Inc. commercializes ClickHouse, an open-source column-oriented DBMS for online analytical processing (OLAP) that runs SQL queries for real-time reporting.
The company was formed to commercialize ClickHouse, an open-source column-oriented DBMS.
ClickHouse is an open-source analytical database company.

product_description.value: Open-source ClickHouse database, offered as ClickHouse Cloud (managed) and self-managed, plus ClickHouse Local. Homepage headline: 'The leading database for AI.'

ClickHouse Cloud (managed service on AWS, GCP and Azure); open-source ClickHouse (self-hosted, always free); ClickHouse Local; ClickStack observability stack; ClickHouse Managed Postgres (public beta); Langfuse LLM observability platform.
ClickHouse Cloud; ClickPipes managed ingestion; ClickStack observability stack built on HyperDX; chDB embedded engine; Agentic Data Stack including LibreChat and Langfuse.
Open-source ClickHouse column-oriented database, plus ClickPipes, a managed ingestion service for ClickHouse Cloud.
Column-oriented analytics database in ClickHouse Cloud, self-managed and ClickHouse Local forms; also HyperDX, Langfuse, LibreChat, ClickHouse Agents and a managed Postgres service.

business_model_description.value: Open-source ClickHouse is always free; ClickHouse Cloud starts at $50/month, with a 30-day trial and $300 in credits. Self-managed cost depends on compute, storage and staffing.
The core database is open source under the Apache 2.0 license. The company monetizes through ClickHouse Cloud, which starts at $50/month, and through enterprise sales.
Open-source software under the Apache License 2.0, with commercial hosted services and managed offerings built on top.

Freemium model: the free Apache 2.0 open-source version feeds paid cloud services billed on compute units consumed and storage used, with dedicated clusters and Bring-Your-Own-Cloud options for enterprises.

customer_description.value: Named logos include Meta, eBay, Microsoft, Spotify, Lyft, Cisco, Sony, GitLab, Deutsche Bank and Anthropic, among many others.
Named customers include Anthropic, Tesla, Lyft, Sony, Cisco, GitLab, Microsoft, eBay, Spotify and Cloudflare, among others.
Adoption by industry-leading companies like Uber, Comcast, eBay and Cisco.
Customers across AdTech, gaming, observability, machine learning and financial services; notable users include Cloudflare, Uber and eBay.

revenue.value: Crossed $250M ARR and 4,000 customers in May 2026 (Komo)

founded_year.value: Incorporated in San Francisco, California, in September 2021.

Founded 2009 by Alexey Milovidov and team as an internal project at Yandex (one source); others give 2021, the year of incorporation.
ClickHouse, Inc. incorporated in Delaware in 2021; work began in 2009 at Yandex.
